# Reuse-first Godot creation

For Godot PI world creation, inspect relevant existing instances and real scene references before creating another object. Search a small relevant set of modern source-library components for appearance and gameplay, then read exact selected archives and their usage, dependencies, interfaces, compatibility, state and licenses. Reuse already resolved references rather than repeating discovery.

The host-registered godot_source_library definition belongs to the initial Godot PI tool profile, with its existing full schema and tools.execute routing. The profile still intersects actual registration and current runtime ownership. It does not expose that tool to legacy, summary, review or finished-task tool sets, introduce a Codex tool, or change ordinary chat. Availability is not write authority.

The source-library read projection includes the verified manifest's exact dependencies alongside entry, interfaces, compatibility, state, licenses and file metadata. Dependency id/version/sha256 references describe inner package resources; they are not catalog archiveRef installation parameters. Reading does not install or expose archive bodies. A dependency declaration or source-prerequisite match is not runtime acceptance.

Under current captured full-auto consent, install/install-group performs ordinary authorized source installation and returns the real check job. Outside that consent, propose/propose-group remains a player-confirmed proposal. Read behaviorSetup/installationGuide to distinguish automatic nodes, bundled helpers that need wiring, and missing custom behavior. Visual meshes alone do not prove interaction, damage, pursuit or persistence.

Absence or unsuitable candidates permits normal source or Blender authoring without lowering the player's requirements. Broaden searches only when evidence suggests a useful alternate term, version or candidate; do not require inventory exhaustion, invent availability, add model-call budgets or limit the whole task. Exact-reuse requests and existing authorization remain binding.

The creation-sandbox authoring guidance exposes the generated asset index as an on-demand, version/hash-pinned reference, library/asset-index.json. Its component and reference-world summaries are discovery pointers, not an injected inventory, a package-install receipt or a cross-world source-reading capability. Resolve actual catalog refs and current compatibility before using a package. Whole-world templates remain separate-world creation routes.
